Hi Anika — great to hear you have procurement alignment. I sketched an orchestration checklist below to make the buy-side handoff straightforward. I copied our GCP partner rep Ashwin for any Marketplace-specific constraints.

High-level drawdown orchestration (proposal):
1) Commit tiers: 0-30% / 31-70% / 71-100% of annual commit — triggers evaluated monthly.
2) Consumption windows: we recommend monthly metering windows that feed into a quarterly reconciliation to reduce invoice churn.
3) Invoice triggers: monthly when a tier boundary is crossed OR quarterly if below 30% movement. 30 days lead time for an invoice to appear (typical GCP timing).
4) Fallback & smoothing: allow a 2-month smoothing buffer to prevent unexpected PO exhaustion (we can front-load credits on month 1 if requested).
5) Ops contacts: 
   - Billing questions: Ben Carter (billing ops)
   - Drawdown sequencing & exceptions: Marissa Cole (co-sell ops)
   - Technical quota/consumption mapping: Karthik Iyer (solutions)

I'll attach a one-page checklist and a sample timeline for your AR team. If procurement wants, we can provide a short mapping file to convert Redwood token/usage lines to Aurora's internal SKU coding.

Would Wednesday 16th at 10am PT work for a 30-min alignment?

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: aurora-drawdown-timeline-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), commit-triggers-checklist.pdf (pdf)
